question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

641, 647, 659, 673, 683, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**Logic: Alternate prime numbers are written starting from 641.**

641 then 643 is skipped next is 647..

Again 653 is skipped and next is 659 and so on. 

**Prime number series:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/772ed908c472b9cddbc7022108aa1e1328da6255bb7b2511a2729d9daf732a52.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
